title: Ordinary conversation atomic turns

commands.name: expanded failure, cancellation, abandonment, identity, corruption, and delete characterization matrix
focused conversation service and file-store neighborhood
CodeAnalytics post snapshot and ownership queries

architectureChecks.name: CodeAnalytics pre/post
architectureChecks.evidence: snap-20260808152229-7024a527 -> snap-20260808153219-7024a527; no blocking errors, diagnostics, open questions, or dependency cycle

architectureChecks.name: durable contract ownership
architectureChecks.evidence: Abstractions owns bounded compensation values; Conversations owns admission, compensation, schema mapping, and validation

architectureChecks.name: single compensation path
architectureChecks.evidence: BuildCompensatedDocument is used by provider-failure/cancellation rollback and explicit/crash abandonment

architectureChecks.name: dependency isolation
architectureChecks.evidence: No Core, MAF, workflow, process, workspace, or Modules dependency was introduced

architectureChecks.name: anti-stub audit
architectureChecks.evidence: No NotImplementedException, TODO, FIXME, or forbidden project semantic was found in the two LLM projects

bugs: Adoption mutated provider and acceleration before invocation but active-turn state did not retain the pre-turn values needed for compensation.
Rename could mutate a document with an active turn.
Admission reserved only the user slot, allowing assistant append to exceed the transcript bound after provider invocation.
Document validation accepted duplicate entry ids and active markers pointing at the wrong role or turn.
deviations: CodeAnalytics reports the pre-existing large-contract-file warning and a new large-file warning for the cohesive versioned file-store DTO owner; extraction/partial splitting was rejected by the bundle architecture guard, and both files remain single-responsibility owners.

acceptance.criterion: Failed or abandoned Adopt restores the original provider and acceleration.
acceptance.evidence: Provider failure, cancellation, explicit abandonment, and new-service persisted crash-recovery tests

acceptance.criterion: Rename during active turn fails typed without changing state.
Near-capacity turn fails before ILlmInvocationPort is called.
Corrupted ActiveTurn metadata fails typed on load.
acceptance.evidence: Identity corruption and legacy active-schema tests return StorageCorrupted

acceptance.criterion: No ordinary failure leaves an orphaned active turn.
acceptance.evidence: Failure, cancellation, invalid context window, explicit abandon, and crash recovery clear the active marker; terminal delete removes the document

residualRisk: Compensation retries compare-and-swap conflicts three times and then fails explicitly; continuous out-of-contract direct-store writers can still prevent recovery and surface that conflict.
